results.name: Neighborhood Roofing East Brunswick
results.notes: Re-checked 2026-11-12. The domain named on the Google listing returns HTTP 500 on apex, www, https and http, and so does /robots.txt and an inner page (/contractor-east-brunswick-nj/). Opened in the browser it renders 'Database Error / Error establishing a database connection', exactly as the record says. Google Maps shows 'Neighborhood Roofing East Brunswick', roofing contractor, 5.0, 139 Rues Ln, 'Open - Closes 8 PM', site neighborhoodroofingllc.com, phone (732) 656-8985 - so the business is still listed and the listing still points at the dead domain. Separate Google listings for the East Brunswick location and the Perth Amboy profile (Birdeye: 5.0, 66 reviews, 313 State St #602, unclaimed) both exist. Two caveats: the cited audit page stormrage.nyc/local-seo-audit/neighborhood-roofing-east-brunswick/ now returns HTTP 410, so the '44 reviews' figure could not be re-verified, and Maps' limited view shows no review count. The two listings look like two town locations rather than duplicates, so 'duplicate-listing confusion' is an inference. Scores reasonable: gap 5 is right (whole site down); evidence 4 is fair and could even be 5; ability to pay 4 is the soft number since there is no headcount or revenue evidence, only review volume - 3 would also be defensible.

results.name: BSG Group LLC / BSG Roofing
results.notes: Re-checked 2026-11-12 on the live site. Confirmed: title is 'Home | My Site 3' (and 'Contact Us | My Site 3' on the contact page); no meta description; zero tel: links (both numbers are plain text); zero application/ld+json blocks; no H1; at 390 px the layout stays ~984 px wide with the logo clipped on the left and nav running off screen; the contact page has one form with labelled fields (first/last name, tel, email, address, message, 'what do you need' checkboxes) and a 'SUBMIT REQUEST' button; 'Book Now' links back to that same contact page. Google Maps shows two separate listings - 'Bsg Group LLc' (5.0, 368 Ryders Ln, 732-421-3500) and 'BSG Roofing, LLC' (No reviews, 732-257-6640) - so the duplicate-listing issue is real. robots.txt was fetched this time: it exists and allows all crawlers with a sitemap, so the 'assumed permissive, unverified' note can be upgraded to verified. One factual slip in an operations signal, not in a top issue: the contact page lists Saturday 8am-4pm as well as Mon-Fri 8am-4pm, so 'Monday-Friday only' understates the hours. Scores reasonable; all four fixes are contained on a small Wix site.

results.name: Pro-Tec Systems

wrong_claims.claim: HTTPS certificate fails with ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID (name mismatch)
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The certificate does fail, but with an incomplete chain ('unable to get local issuer certificate'), not a name mismatch; the hostname on the cert is fine, the intermediate issuer is missing.

wrong_claims.claim: dozens of injected spam links are hidden on every page
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The injected prada/gucci/'instagram followers'/chatgpt anchors are rendered visibly - 16px inline links with non-zero bounding boxes on the home and feedback pages (119 anchors on the home page) - not hidden. The compromise and link-farm risk still stands, and it is arguably worse because visitors see it.

results.notes: Everything else holds. Home page title is just 'Home', no meta description, no viewport meta tag (so no mobile layout at all), zero tel: links, zero JSON-LD, table-era FrontPage markup, visible 'Copyright 2008' era footer, and the phone 732-828-7756 as plain text. /feedback.htm still posts to _derived/nortbots.htm with a FrontPage-era field set (comments, category, contact block), so the form cannot deliver. robots.txt returns HTTP 404, as stated. Google Maps: 'Pro-Tec Systems Inc', 5.0, mis-categorised as 'General contractor', 'Claim this business', 'Add hours', no photos, same phone and protecsystems.net domain. Two wording corrections above; the findings, opportunities and scores stand. One small calibration note: findable 0 is harsh for a listing that does exist with the right address, phone and domain - 1 would be fairer - but that is an internal sub-score, not one of the four ranking scores.

data_gaps: Google Maps consistently served a 'limited view' with no review count, so review totals for B00432 (East Brunswick), B00434, B00440, B00675, B00787, B00895 and B00934 could not be re-verified from Google directly; counts quoted in records come from Birdeye mirrors where those exist.

B00432: the cited audit page stormrage.nyc/local-seo-audit/neighborhood-roofing-east-brunswick/ now returns HTTP 410 and no Birdeye profile for the East Brunswick location was found, so the '44 reviews' figure and the duplicate-listing interpretation could not be re-verified.

No page required a login, form submission or account creation; nothing was submitted anywhere.
